description: TPU v4 reference-only metadata archived from the active execution profile. Not a simulation configuration; the runtime does not load or merge this file.

register_file_chip_bytes.source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2304.01433 (PDF p7, Table 4; PDF p10, section 7.5)
register_file_chip_bytes.conditions: 0.25 MiB = 262144 bytes per chip, supported by Table 4 and section 7.5. Aggregate physical inventory only; no per-TensorCore ownership, allocation, spill or timing model. Count once per chip; do not multiply or divide by tensorcores_per_chip.

ici_links_per_chip.conditions: Inventory only; mesh/torus selection depends on the slice.

ici_link_reported_bytes_per_second.conditions: Reported 50 GB/s/link; directional interpretation is unresolved in this profile. Do not use as one-way payload bandwidth.

process_node_nm.conditions: Reported process node; no technology scaling model.

die_area_upper_bound_mm2.conditions: Strict upper bound: die area <600 mm2; neither exact area nor a component area coefficient.

nominal_int8_tops.conditions: Official table labels bf16 or int8 as 275 teraflops; INT8 is reported here as TOPS with 2 operations per MAC.

vpus_per_tensorcore.conditions: Vector unit inventory, not executed by the counter.

vpu_lanes.conditions: ALU inventory does not specify operation throughput.

vpu_alus_per_lane.conditions: Do not convert ALU count to a per-op effective rate.

interconnect.topology: 3D mesh; full cubes can form 3D torus or supported twisted torus slices
interconnect.conditions: Specification only; no links, routing or collectives are executed. Link direction and effective payload bandwidth remain unverified.

archival_reasons.register_file_chip_bytes: Aggregate register inventory only; no register allocation, spill or timing model.
archival_reasons.ici_links_per_chip: ICI is retired from execution. Link inventory/reported bandwidth/topology display only; no network transfer or collectives.
archival_reasons.ici_link_reported_bytes_per_second: ICI is retired from execution. Link inventory/reported bandwidth/topology display only; no network transfer or collectives.
archival_reasons.process_node_nm: Only provenance remains; no process scaling, timing, energy or area model reads this value.
archival_reasons.die_area_upper_bound_mm2: Displayed die-area upper bound, not an enforced model constraint or a computed area.
archival_reasons.nominal_int8_tops: Published nominal peak was a display-only reference, distinct from the retained geometry-derived peak.
archival_reasons.vpus_per_tensorcore: VPU count was used only for physical inventory; the standalone Vector service has an explicit fixed budget.
archival_reasons.vpu_lanes: VPU lane geometry was used only for ALU inventory; it is not a runtime fallback for Vector throughput.
archival_reasons.vpu_alus_per_lane: ALUs per VPU lane were used only for ALU inventory; Vector work consumes the independently configured budget and costs.
